name: Revenue {OS}

group.label: 04 · GROW
group.purpose: Turn value into distribution and revenue

tagline: Business cash flow, CRM, billing and receivables.

commands.name: /revenue
commands.returns: Cash, receivables, pipeline and the next decision that is due.

commands.name: /pipeline
commands.does: Reviews the pipeline and the forecast.
commands.returns: Pipeline state and a forecast range with its assumptions stated.

commands.name: /lead
commands.does: Creates or inspects the commercial record for a lead.
commands.returns: A CRM record with source and stage evidence.

commands.name: /proposal
commands.does: Builds the commercial logic of a proposal.
commands.returns: Figures, terms and the consequence of a scope change.

commands.name: /invoice
commands.does: Drafts an invoice and issues it once approved.
commands.returns: An invoice draft, issued only on approval of the exact figures.

commands.name: /collections
commands.returns: An ageing view, one action per invoice, and an unsent message.

commands.name: /business-cashflow
commands.returns: A cash position with runway dates and the variables that move it.

commands.name: /receipt-business
commands.does: Stages a business receipt or photo as evidence.
commands.returns: A staged extraction with its source and confidence level.

commands.name: /contract
commands.does: Stages contract data as a commercial record.
commands.returns: Terms, dates and obligations, staged for confirmation.

commands.name: /revenue-close
commands.does: Runs the monthly commercial and financial close.
commands.returns: Reconciled accounts and a named exception list.

commands.name: /revenue-scenario
commands.returns: Scenarios as ranges with falsifiable assumptions.

commands.name: /renewal
commands.does: Takes the renewal decision on the delivery signals.
commands.returns: The decision, citing the signals it accepted or overrode.

handoffs.artifact: closed won commitment and agreed scope

requires_human_approval_for: sending an invoice, on the exact figures, line items and recipient
sending any collections message, on the exact text
any change to a signed contract
applying a discount outside the published policy
closing a period that still has unreconciled accounts
recording a renewal decision that contradicts the delivery signals
